title: Creative Change Kind
description: A kind of change a sync_creatives item makes to a creative, classified from the item's diff against the version of the creative that serves. Buyer and seller compute the same classification, so a buyer can tell before it sends a change which live-update rules apply. Fields excluded from canonical revision content (name, tags, status, weight, placement_refs, placement_ids) are not a change kind.

enumDescriptions.click_through: A url asset with url_type clickthrough was added, removed, or changed.
enumDescriptions.trackers: A url asset with url_type tracker_pixel or tracker_script, or a pixel_tracker, vast_tracker, or daast_tracker asset, was added, removed, or changed.
enumDescriptions.asset_content: Any other asset was added, removed, or changed, including markup or VAST that embeds clicks or trackers; or localization or representation_selection changed.
